note: Necrogenesis Moon season for GraveGain MMO endgame (games lane, v2-native). A limited-time cross-game season: the dead moon waxes over all three games, bosses regenerate unless every front holds 20%, moon-herald warbands lead the night shift. ASCII only.

modifiers.effect: Bosses regenerate 5% per hour unless every front holds at least 20% of threshold
moon-heralds warbands deal +10% damage all season (stacks with their banner bonus)
Codex boss entries rank up twice as fast during the season

rewards.detail: Seasonal loot cache per boss week survived at full moons
Warbands that kill the Marrow Choir during the season earn the moonsinger title
